answer_1.quote: We seek to study the real-world scenario of conversational question answering over financial reports - investors or analysts would typically ask sequential questions to get insights into the numerical in the reports.
answer_1.outputs: reasoning programs and answers to sequential questions

answer_2.quote: We follow the same evaluation metric as in FinQA, the execution accuracy to evaluate the final execution result and program accuracy to evaluate program equivalence.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of CONVFINQA and establish human performance references, we sample 200 example questions and distribute to both the expert and laymen annotators to answer.
answer_4.guideline: The two expert annotators reach an average execution accuracy of 89.44% and program accuracy of 86.34%, with an agreement rate over 85.0% for both metrics.
